common.Control.new: needs project management: the studio serves the one project directory it was launched on (`eda board serve -C dir`) and has no verb to create a new project or document, so there is nothing for New to start
common.Control.open: needs project management: the studio serves one project directory chosen at launch and has no verb to open or switch to another project
common.API.pluginsReload: needs a plugin system: the studio has no Python scripting or API plugins (`pcbnew.ScriptingTool.*` is recorded for the same reason), so there are no plugins to reload and no plugin menus to refresh
common.Control.quit: a web page has no application to quit: closing the tab ends the session, the server (`eda board serve`) keeps running and every edit is already in design.json
common.Control.showProjectManager: needs the KiCad project manager: the studio is one window on the one project directory it was launched on (`eda board serve -C dir`), with no project manager frame to switch to (GAPS.md: project management)
common.Control.revert: every edit is written to design.json when it is made (why Save only reports), so a document never holds unsaved changes to discard -- KiCad enables Revert only for a modified document, and here Undo (the shared history) is what steps back through edits
common.Control.showCalculatorTools: the calculators are a separate program (KiCad starts pcb_calculator with `Execute( PCB_CALCULATOR_EXE )`); the studio has no calculator and, in a browser, no program to start
common.Control.undoZoom: ACTIONS::zoomUndo is the simulator plot's zoom history (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::UndoZoom over the mathplot zoom stack); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last) and the canvases keep no zoom history
common.Control.redoZoom: ACTIONS::zoomRedo is the simulator plot's zoom history (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::RedoZoom); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last) and the canvases keep no zoom history
common.Control.zoomInHorizontally: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)
common.Control.zoomOutHorizontally: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)
common.Control.zoomInVertically: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)
common.Control.zoomOutVertically: a zoom of the simulator's plot (SIMULATOR_CONTROL::Zoom, the plot toolbar); the studio has no simulator (GAPS.md: Simulator, last)

common.Control.openDirectory: opens the library's folder in the operating system's file manager (`canOpenExternally`); a web page cannot open a file manager

common.Embed.embededFile: needs embedded files: KiCad stores them zstd-compressed and base64-encoded with a SHA-256 checksum in the .kicad_pcb / .kicad_mod, the design IR has no embedded-file list, and without a zstd implementation (no new dependencies) a file embedded here could not be read back from a KiCad file
common.Embed.removeFile: needs embedded files: see common.Embed.embededFile; the design IR holds no embedded files to remove
common.Embed.extractFile: needs embedded files: see common.Embed.embededFile; the design IR holds no embedded files to extract

pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.applyDesignBlo: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so no group can be linked to a block layout
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.barcode: needs barcode items (PCB_BARCODE: a barcode or QR code generated from text); the design IR has no barcode item or encoder and no new dependencies are allowed
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.drawTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeCharacter: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board characteristics as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeLinkedDes: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no block to link to a group or place
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placePoint: needs point items (PCB_POINT: reference/snap points stored on the board); the design IR has no point item and the snapping code knows no such anchor
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeReference: needs reference-image items (PCB_REFERENCE_IMAGE: a bitmap on a graphic layer, kept out of every output); the design IR has no image item
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.placeStackup: needs table items (PCB_TABLE): it places the board stackup as a table on a graphic layer; the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.saveToLinkedDe: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-board blocks); this studio has no block library or block IR, so there is no linked block to save a group to
pcbnew.InteractiveDrawing.textbox: needs text-box items (PCB_TEXTBOX: wrapped text in a bordered box); the design IR's Text is plain text with no box, border or wrapping
pcbnew.TableEditor.editTable: needs table items (PCB_TABLE); the design IR has no table type
pcbnew.PadTool.explodePad: a custom pad is in the IR (its anchor and basic shapes, edited in Pad Properties), but its exploded form -- the shapes as free graphic items of the footprint, `PAD_TOOL::EditPad` -- has no verb
pcbnew.PadTool.recombinePad: a custom pad is in the IR (its anchor and basic shapes, edited in Pad Properties), but merging the selected graphic items back into the pad being edited -- `PAD_TOOL::recombinePad` -- has no verb
pcbnew.Control.layerChanged: an internal notification (AF_NOTIFY) the editor posts to its own tools when the active layer changes, not a command: the studio's tools read the active layer from the store when they redraw, so there is no event to deliver or answer
pcbnew.EditorControl.angleSnapModeChange: an internal notification (AF_NOTIFY) posted after the line mode changes, whose only job is to refresh the toolbar's line-mode icon; the studio's toolbar reads the mode from the store, so there is no event to deliver or answer
pcbnew.EditorControl.trackViaSizeChanged: an internal notification (AF_NOTIFY) posted after the track or via size changes so the router and drawing tools refresh; the studio's tools read the sizes from the store when they redraw, so there is no event to deliver or answer
pcbnew.Control.hideDynamicRatsnest: an internal event the move tool posts when a drag ends (HideLocalRatsnest); the studio's move preview computes its dynamic ratsnest itself and drops it on commit (kicad-port/localRatsnest.ts), so nothing posts or answers it
pcbnew.Control.updateLocalRatsnest: an internal event the move tool posts on every pointer move with the drag delta (UpdateLocalRatsnest); the studio's move preview recomputes its dynamic ratsnest itself (kicad-port/localRatsnest.ts), so nothing posts or answers it
pcbnew.EditorControl.highlightItem: has no menu, toolbar or hotkey entry and nothing in pcbnew posts it: it only exists to be posted with the item to select as its parameter (a programmatic route, like cross-probing from the schematic, which in this studio is a shared selection), and an action with no item to carry has nothing to highlight
pcbnew.EditorControl.drillSetOrigin: has no menu, toolbar or hotkey entry and nothing in pcbnew posts it: it only exists to be posted with the origin point as its parameter (a programmatic route; the studio has no scripting); Drill/Place File Origin (click to place) and Reset Drill Origin are the user-facing two
pcbnew.Control.rehatchShapes: needs hatched shape fills (FILL_T::HATCH, REVERSE_HATCH, CROSS_HATCH) whose hatch lines are rebuilt; the design IR's graphic shapes are solid or unfilled (`filled: bool`), so there are no hatch lines to rebuild
pcbnew.Control.fpAutoZoom: needs the Footprint Viewer window (FOOTPRINT_VIEWER_FRAME), the only place this toggle (automatic zoom when the footprint changes) acts; the studio has the Footprint Editor tab but no separate viewer
pcbnew.Control.nextFootprint: needs the Footprint Viewer window (FOOTPRINT_VIEWER_FRAME), the only place it acts (it steps through the viewer's footprint list); the studio has the Footprint Editor tab but no separate viewer
pcbnew.Control.previousFootprint: needs the Footprint Viewer window (FOOTPRINT_VIEWER_FRAME), the only place it acts (it steps through the viewer's footprint list); the studio has the Footprint Editor tab but no separate viewer
pcbnew.EditorControl.collect3DModels: needs embedded files (the 3D models stored inside the board); the design IR has no embedded-files section and the KiCad exporter writes none, so there is nowhere to put the collected models
pcbnew.EditorControl.importNetlist: needs a netlist importer that can add parts and nets: the board's parts and nets come from the intent and the schematic (Update PCB from Schematic is the one way they change), and no verb adds a part or net to the intent-derived constraint model for a netlist read from a file
pcbnew.EditorControl.openNonKicadBoard: needs project management: it replaces the open board with an imported one (kicad-cli pcb import could convert the file), but the studio serves the one project directory it was launched on and has no verb to open or switch to another; same reason as Open
pcbnew.EditorControl.rescueAutosave: needs autosave files: every edit is written to design.json at once and kept in .history, so there is no separate rescue file to restore from
pcbnew.EditorControl.exportSpecctraDSN: needs the Specctra DSN/SES interchange (SPECCTRA_DB); kicad-cli has no DSN or SES command, and the studio's autorouter (crates/freeroute) reads and writes design.json directly, with no DSN round-trip
pcbnew.EditorControl.importSpecctraSessi: needs the Specctra DSN/SES interchange (SPECCTRA_DB); kicad-cli has no DSN or SES command, and the studio's autorouter (crates/freeroute) reads and writes design.json directly, with no DSN round-trip
pcbnew.EditorControl.exportIDF: needs an IDF exporter; kicad-cli (10.99) has no IDF export, and writing one here would be a second exporter next to kicad-cli (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.EditorControl.exportHyperlynx: needs a Hyperlynx exporter; kicad-cli (10.99) has no Hyperlynx export, and writing one here would be a second exporter next to kicad-cli (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.EditorControl.generateReportFile: needs a footprint-report (.rpt) exporter; kicad-cli (10.99) has no such export, and writing one here would be a second exporter next to kicad-cli (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: never duplicate kicad-cli)
pcbnew.DRETool.drcRuleEditor: the rule editor is a rule-tree designer with a panel per constraint type that writes the .kicad_dru; Board Setup > Custom Rules edits that file as text (with a syntax check by kicad-cli), the designer is not ported
pcbnew.Multichannel.generatePlacementRul: needs placement rule areas and component classes (MULTICHANNEL_TOOL builds a rule area per channel from hierarchical sheets or component classes, and matches footprints between them); the zone IR has keepout rule areas only, there are no component classes, and a placed footprint carries no sheet path
pcbnew.Multichannel.repeatLayout: needs placement rule areas and component classes (MULTICHANNEL_TOOL clones one channel's placement and routing into the others by matching the footprints of two rule areas); the zone IR has keepout rule areas only, there are no component classes, and a placed footprint carries no sheet path

eeschema.InteractiveSelection.SyncSelect: an internal action with no label, hotkey or menu entry that KiCad never runs as an action (cross-probing and the symbol fields table call SCH_SELECTION_TOOL::SyncSelection directly), so there is nothing a user could invoke
eeschema.EditorControl.ddAddImage: a drag-and-drop handler with no menu entry (`SCH_EDITOR_CONTROL::DdAddImage`: an image file dropped on the sheet becomes a bitmap item); the design IR has no bitmap item (only vector shapes, text boxes and directive labels), so a dropped image has nothing to become (the window takes drops since components/FileDropHost.tsx, and says so)
eeschema.EditorControl.ddAppendFile: a drag-and-drop handler with no menu entry (`DdAppendFile`: a schematic file dropped on the sheet runs Import Sheet with that file). The window takes drops now (components/FileDropHost.tsx), but Import Sheet reads a schematic file from a path on the server (`Cmd::ImportSheet` { source }), and a browser drop gives the page a file's bytes and not its path: the sheets and symbol libraries a dropped schematic refers to are found relative to its own folder, which a dropped file does not have. Use Import Sheet... on a file of the project
eeschema.EditorControl.importNonKicadSch: needs importers for other EDA formats (Eagle, CADSTAR, EasyEDA, gEDA, ...: KiCad's `SCH_IO` plugins); the studio reads KiCad schematics only (`eda import-kicad`) and no new dependencies are allowed
eeschema.EditorControl.remapSymbols: needs legacy symbol libraries (`.lib` / `.dcm` files) to remap old library references from; the studio has none -- its symbols link by `Library:Name` ids, which Bulk Edit Symbol Library Links already edits
eeschema.EditorControl.rescueSymbols: needs the symbol cache a schematic keeps next to its libraries, to rescue a symbol whose library copy has changed; the studio keeps no cache of its own, a placed symbol is resolved from the libraries or the project library on every load, so there is nothing to rescue
eeschema.RemoteSymbols.showPanel: needs KiCad's remote symbol providers (online part libraries reached through the user's account); no such service is reachable from here and nothing may be downloaded
eeschema.EditorControl.generateBOMExtern: an action KiCad defines (sch_actions.cpp) but binds to nothing: no tool's `setTransitions` handles it and no menu offers it, so there is no behavior to port

eeschema.EditorControl.removeVariant: needs design variants: per-variant overrides of the DNP, exclude-from-BOM, exclude-from-board and exclude-from-simulation flags and of the fields (`SCH_SYMBOL` variants, `SCHEMATIC::SetCurrentVariant`), which the design IR does not model

eeschema.EditorControl.togglePinAltIcons: needs pin alternate functions: the library symbol IR has no `(alternate ...)` pin definitions, so no pin has an alternate-function icon to show
eeschema.EditorControl.annotateAutomatic: the studio numbers a symbol with the next free number of its prefix the moment it is placed (a real reference, never a `U?` placeholder), so a symbol is never unannotated and there is no automatic-annotation switch to turn on or off
eeschema.EditorControl.restartMove: an internal action with no label, hotkey or menu entry: the selection and move tools post it to each other to restart a move after the selection changed, nothing a user could invoke
eeschema.EditorControl.updateNetHighligh: an internal action with no label, hotkey or menu entry (`SCH_EDITOR_CONTROL::UpdateNetHighlighting` recomputes the highlight after the connectivity changed); the studio's highlight is a net name that repaints with every edit, so nothing has to be recomputed
eeschema.SchDesignBlockControl.deleteDes: needs a design-block library (reusable sub-schematics saved with a description and keywords, and the library table that lists them) and the schematic clipboard that places one: the design IR has no block type and the schematic has no copy and paste, so a saved block could not be used
